description: This file implements various utility functions for embedded firmware, including string manipulation, numeric conversions, mathematical functions, and logging related helpers, with some custom implementations due to limitations in the environment.

methods.name: boolToString
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to 'Yes' or 'No' string.

methods.name: minI
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two integers.

methods.name: efiRound
methods.description: Rounds a float to specified precision.

methods.name: absF
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of a float.

methods.name: absI
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of an int32_t.

methods.name: maxI
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two integers.

methods.name: maxF
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two floats.

methods.name: minF
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two floats.

methods.name: efiStrlen
methods.description: Calculates length of a string.

methods.name: efiTrim
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing spaces from a string.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if a line starts with a given prefix.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds index of character in a string.

methods.name: atoi
methods.description: Converts string to integer.

methods.name: ltoa_internal
methods.description: Converts a long integer to string in given radix.

methods.name: itoa_signed
methods.description: Converts signed integer to string with radix.

methods.name: itoa10
methods.description: Converts integer to decimal string.

methods.name: isSameF
methods.description: Checks if two floats are approximately equal.

methods.name: efiPow10
methods.description: Calculates 10 raised to an integer power.

methods.name: atoff
methods.description: Converts string to float, supporting NaN.

methods.name: strEqualCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison.

methods.name: mytolower
methods.description: Converts a character to lowercase if uppercase.

methods.name: strEqual
methods.description: Checks if two strings are equal.

methods.name: printHistogram
methods.description: Prints a histogram summary via logging.

methods.name: limitRateOfChange
methods.description: Limits the rate of change of a value based on time and limits.

methods.name: expf_taylor
methods.description: Computes exponential using Taylor series approximation.
